mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patrol_record (round_id, task_ref, query, agent_id, status, score, duration_ms, error_summary, trace_id, create_time) VALUES (#{roundId}, #{taskRef}, #{query}, #{agentId}, #{status}, #{score}, #{durationMs}, #{errorSummary}, #{traceId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, round_id, task_ref, query, agent_id, status, score, duration_ms, error_summary, trace_id, create_time FROM patrol_record ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, round_id, task_ref, query, agent_id, status, score, duration_ms, error_summary, trace_id, create_time FROM patrol_record ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, round_id, task_ref, query, agent_id, status, score, duration_ms, error_summary, trace_id, create_time FROM patrol_record WHERE round_id = #{roundId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, round_id, task_ref, query, agent_id, status, score, duration_ms, error_summary, trace_id, create_time FROM patrol_record WHERE status <> 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
